SELECT B.alarm_category AS item, COUNT(A.id) AS cnt FROM alarm_event A LEFT JOIN alarm_point B ON A.alarm_point_id = B.id WHERE A.del_flag = 0
AND A.alarm_time >= #{startTime}
AND A.alarm_time < #{endTime}
AND A.dept_code LIKE
#{factoryCode} || '%'
CONCAT(#{factoryCode}, '%')
GROUP BY B.alarm_category
